newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kirin Brewery sees '96 earnings less than forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kirin Brewery sees '96 earnings less than forecast.

text.p: Kirin Brewery Co Ltd said on Thursday that its sales and profits in the current business year to December 31 would not reach its forecast announced earlier this year.
"Our shipments are smaller than those of a year ago, so it is likely that we will not be able to achieve our sales and profit forecasts," a Kirin spokeswoman said.
She declined to provide new forecasts for 1996 sales and profits.
Kirin said earlier this year that it would post parent current profit of 65 billion yen in 1996 against its actual 1995 profit of 75.3 billion yen in 1995.
Economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that Kirin's 1996 current profit would slip to 52 billion yen, mainly due to severe competition from rival beer makers.
